description: r60 (PLAN A7 (a), B200 screen, step-capped): r58's config (A 005's recipe, the entropy floor at coef 0.05 below 0.1, keep_best_dev) on a longer schedule: cosine over 875 steps, stopped at 700 (A 005 and r40 use 500 and 400). The lr ends at the same 1.9e-7 and is 6.1e-7 at step 400. Evals every 50 steps count on the clock (keep_best_dev), and the 17,400-s budget still stops the run. Read against r40's box seeds at step 400 (0.372) and r58 when it has run; the eval log gives the kept eval and the last one.
